options.name: get
options.doc: The only handler an upgrade service has. Runs on the initial HTTP request and decides whether to upgrade the connection. Return the service that will handle the resulting connection, or an UpgradeError to reject the upgrade.

params.name: request
params.doc: The HTTP request that initiated the upgrade, inspect its headers here to authenticate or route before accepting.

options.name: onOpen
options.doc: Invoked once, after the handshake completes and the connection is established.

params.name: caller
params.doc: Handle for sending messages back over this connection.

options.name: onMessage
options.doc: Invoked for every inbound message, text or binary alike. Declaring this handler rules out onTextMessage and onBinaryMessage, it already covers both. It is also the fallback for a custom message type that matched no dispatched handler.

params.name: caller
params.doc: Handle for sending messages back over this connection.

params.name: data
params.doc: The inbound message. A text frame deserializes straight to the declared type. A binary frame is read as bytes and then deserialized, unless the declared type is byte[]. A binding failure closes the connection with status 1003.

options.name: onTextMessage
options.doc: Invoked for every inbound text frame.

params.name: caller
params.doc: Handle for sending messages back over this connection.

params.name: text
params.doc: The text frame's content.

options.name: onBinaryMessage
options.doc: Invoked for every inbound binary frame.

params.name: caller
params.doc: Handle for sending messages back over this connection.

params.name: data
params.doc: The binary frame's content.

options.name: onPing
options.doc: Invoked when the peer sends a ping frame. Declaring it makes replying your responsibility, without it the library sends the pong automatically.

params.name: caller
params.doc: Handle for sending messages back over this connection.

params.name: data
params.doc: The ping frame's application data.

options.name: onPong
options.doc: Invoked when the peer sends a pong frame, normally in reply to a ping this service sent.

params.name: caller
params.doc: Handle for sending messages back over this connection.

params.name: data
params.doc: The pong frame's application data.

options.name: onIdleTimeout
options.doc: Invoked when no message has arrived for the idleTimeout set in the service config. The listener's own timeout does not trigger it, that one covers only the initial upgrade request.

params.name: caller
params.doc: Handle for sending messages back over this connection.

options.name: onClose
options.doc: Invoked when a close frame arrives from the peer.

params.name: caller
params.doc: Handle for this connection, already closing, sends will not reach the peer.

params.name: statusCode
params.doc: The WebSocket close status code the peer sent.

params.name: reason
params.doc: The human-readable close reason the peer sent.

options.name: onError
options.doc: Invoked when the connection fails, always preceded by a connection closure with the matching close frame. Also the fallback for a binding failure when no matching custom error handler is declared.

params.name: caller
params.doc: Handle for sending messages back over this connection.

params.name: err
params.doc: The failure that interrupted the connection.

options.doc: A custom dispatched handler. When the service config sets a dispatcherKey, the value of that field in an inbound message picks the handler by name: the value is camel cased and prefixed with on, so an event of "heartbeat" reaches onHeartbeat. A DispatcherConfig annotation overrides that derivation with an explicit dispatcherValue. A message matching nothing falls back to onMessage, or is ignored when that is absent too.

params.name: caller
params.doc: Handle for sending messages back over this connection.

params.name: message
params.doc: The inbound message, bound to the declared type.

options.doc: A custom error handler, paired to a dispatched handler by name: that handler's name plus Error, so onHeartbeat pairs with onHeartbeatError. It receives the binding failure for that message type. Without it the failure falls back to onError.

params.name: caller
params.doc: Handle for sending messages back over this connection.

params.name: err
params.doc: The failure that prevented the message from binding.

rules.message: onMessage and onTextMessage cannot coexist, onMessage already receives text frames.
onMessage and onBinaryMessage cannot coexist, onMessage already receives binary frames.
